why does search miss pages added this week?
Search is built from an index that is only regenerated on release, so pages added since the
last release are missing. I'm checking whether the build can regenerate it on every deploy.
Find where the search index is built
Measure index build time on a full deploy
Build the site with the index …

● W O R K I N G
bisecting the three payment tests that fail one run in twenty
find out why the payment tests are flaky and fix them
Three tests fail intermittently, all in the payments suite. I'm running each two hundred
times under load to find which ones share a cause.
Two of the three share a cause: both read the clock twice and assume the same second. The
third is separate. I've started a workflow with one agent per test, and a reviewer to
Bisect and fix the flaky payment tests
